notes.title: Update: tutorial and interface improvement
notes.content:
Hello everyone !

The first Night&Scape update is available!

[h2]Changes :[/h2]

Added "Training Zone" (tutorial)
Character design changes
Game screen redesign
Added indicator for revealed nightmares
Changed item exchange mechanics
Added sound elements

And bugs have been fixed,
